title: Footage window that morphs through shapes
summary: A small rectangle opens on a flat pastel field and grows into a portrait window onto footage, then bends through a notched bow, a twisting pinwheel and a square before locking into an hourglass. The clip never cuts; the mask is the motion.
use_when: Opening a film on one strong clip without a hard cut
Silent loop or social teaser where a single shot needs more life
A mask transition into hero footage or a product video
Brands with a geometric mark the final shape can echo

sfx.event: mask bends into a new shape
mask locks into the final hourglass

structure.shot: flat pale cyan field; a small landscape window onto sky footage with a figure opens at centre and grows into a portrait rectangle
structure.camera: locked frame, no camera move; footage scale constant inside the window
structure.motion: window 0 -> ~12 % W landscape at 0.27, -> portrait 15 % W x 47 % H by 0.77, settled 1.00; springs.layout ~22 fr (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the portrait window bends: short sides bow, then concave notches cut into both long sides, forming a notched bow shape ~25 % W
structure.camera: locked frame; footage push-in starts inside the mask, 1.00 -> 1.15
structure.motion: path morph rect -> notched bow, springs.ui ~15 fr (±0.25 s); shape tilts ~5 deg by 2.27; footage scale 1.00 -> 1.15 easings.inOutSine

structure.shot: the bow twists into a four-lobed pinwheel ~40 % W, folds back into a near square ~30 % W, then pinches into an hourglass
structure.camera: locked frame; footage push-in to ~1.5 at 2.50, pull-out back to 1.0 by 3.77
structure.motion: pinwheel at 2.50 rotated ~-20 deg; square at 3.00 ~-3 deg, 3.27 ~+6 deg; twist ~-25 deg at 3.50; each state springs.ui ~8 fr apart (±0.25 s); rotation 6 -> 15 deg/s

structure.shot: the window holds as an upright hourglass with rounded corners, 24 % W x 47 % H, figure small in the waist
structure.motion: settled by 4.00 (springs.ui, ±0.25 s); no motion for 31 fr to the end

params.brand: any brand.json: bg fills the field around the window, accent unused by default
params.content.clip: footage file (or image) shown through the window; a calm subject on a clean background reads best
params.content.shapes: ordered mask keyframes: rect, notched bow, pinwheel, square, hourglass (path ids)
params.content.finalShape: the shape the window locks into; can be the brand mark silhouette
params.timing.open: frames for the point -> portrait open (default 23)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Single shot, 0 cuts, silent reference; sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Sizes from 4 fps sheet cells (±0.25 s): window 15 % W x 47 % H at 1.00, pinwheel ~40 % W at 2.50, hourglass 24 % W x 47 % H from 3.77. Footage scales ~1.0 -> 1.5 -> 1.0 inside the mask between 1.5 and 3.8 s (keyframes 2.50 vs 4.50). Rotation per motion.json 6 deg/s (2-3 s), 15 deg/s (3-4 s). Proposed term: shape-mask-morph (a clip mask whose path morphs through several shapes); not used as an id.
